workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M756 admits constrained objective design from M755 corpus

hypothesis: A constrained v4 sequence objective can be designed from M755 positives and matched normals while treating hard negatives as optional sparse contrast.
success_criteria: M757 specifies objective terms and exact metrics
M757 specifies normal retention first-step safety and source-balance gates
M757 specifies how sparse hard negatives are used without biasing the objective
M757 keeps actor inputs clean and claim-boundary metadata as training-time logging only
M757 admits only an offline/exact objective sanity implementation
failure_criteria: design requires hard negatives for every positive
design leaks hidden fault labels into actor observations
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion directly
decision_rule: M757 may only design an offline v4 sequence objective. It must not implement actor updates PPO or promotion until a follow-up implementation/sanity gate is registered.
